author: devbig030
body:
RESOLVED in worktree agent/skipped-tests (task fix-tests-asserting-nothing). Left OPEN pending owner review; not pushed.

Sweep found 12, not ~10: this bead's list missed test_bug1_canonical_per_sha_discrimination and test_lavd_dsq_length_queries.

DISPOSITION
- DELETED 2 (compare.rs test_load_real_bpf_trace, test_full_real_vs_sim_comparison). Gated on a bpf_trace.log nothing in the repo produces, so they never executed in any run, ever. test_full_real_vs_sim_comparison had zero assertions even on the never-taken path -- it only printed a report. Already covered with real assertions on synthetic input by test_bpf_trace_parsing and test_bpf_vs_simulated_comparison; manual procedure preserved as a comment.
- IGNORED 1 (test_bug1_canonical_per_sha_discrimination) -> now visible in the skip COUNT instead of silently green. Also closed its second hole: with the env set but an empty cache it used to print a note and pass; it now asserts that >= 2 SHAs were actually compared.
- ASSERTED 9 (7 scx_perf + perfetto_pb + test_lavd_dsq_length_queries).

MECHANISM (this bead's proposals 1-3) -- new scx_perf::capability module:
- Capability ABSENT (no PMU / perf_event_open denied / tool missing) now PANICS by default, naming SCXSIM_ALLOW_MISSING_CAPS as the explicit opt-out. validate.sh probes via a new probe_caps example and declares only what is genuinely absent, so capability-less CI stays green while the skip is announced (SCXSIM-CAPABILITY-SKIP marker) and recorded in validate.sh's existing end-of-run SKIPPED summary.
- Capability PRESENT but degenerate is NOT routed through that path: it asserts. That killed the vacuous 'if count == 0 { return } assert!(count > 0)' shape this bead flagged, which could not fail on ANY machine.

Deliberately did NOT #[ignore] the hardware tests: that would stop them running on capable hardware in the default nextest run, recreating the dead-coverage rot just removed from the stress trio.

EVIDENCE: every rewritten assertion proven to fail by mutation -- stuck RbcCounter::read, stuck RdpmcHandle::read, no-op set_period, no-op HwBreakpoint::enable, empty dsq_samples, hidden trace_processor, unset/empty bin cache. test_rbc_timer_set_period previously asserted NOTHING; it now catches a no-op set_period.

Workspace 998 passed/11 skipped -> 1004 passed/12 skipped, 0 failed. fmt clean, no new clippy findings.

NOT DONE: proposal 4 (an allowlist assertion so a newly-silent test cannot hide). Filed separately.
